defects.title: A name listed twice is reported as not present in the map
defects.trigger: removeCDReactions(fileName, {'R3', 'R3'}) on a map that contains R3
defects.observed: MATLAB R2025a prints 'R3 not present in the map' (ismember returns only the first position of R3 in the list, so the second position is counted as missing); R3 is removed.
defects.expected: no message, as R3 is in the map

defects.title: A species that only modifies removed reactions is kept
defects.trigger: removeCDReactions(fileName, {'R1'}) where species E (alias sa5) is only the catalyst (modifier) of R1
defects.observed: MATLAB R2025a: R1, species A and alias sa1 are removed; species E and alias sa5 stay in the written map although no remaining reaction uses them (map.sID and map.sAlias hold reactants and products only, not modifiers).
defects.expected: E and sa5 removed with R1, as for reactants and products

notes: The test file left by the stopped helper was reviewed against the contract and kept unchanged: it passes under the coverage tool with the documented exemptions (lines 27, 29, 31, 32, 33 are inside 'if 0', dead code) and no leftover. Both defects were re-confirmed by a probe on the test's toy map (MATLAB R2025a): removeCDReactions(mapFile, {'R3','R3'}) prints 'R3 not present in the map' and writes R1, R2; removeCDReactions(mapFile, {'R1'}, 0) writes specID s2, s3, s4, s5 and molAlias sa2, sa3, sa4, sa5 (E/sa5 kept). Run-time callees outside src/: xml2struct, struct2xml (external/base/io). No quarantined function is reached.

Expected widths and colours by hand from the documented bands and shade lists of addFluxFromFileWidthAndColor (tested callee); the default output name is written to the current folder, so the test cd's into its tempname folder for that section. Reaction widths come back as text ('10', '5', '1') because transformMap2XML/struct2xml write numbers as attributes. No quarantined function is reached.

The Parallel Computing Toolbox is licensed on the reference machine, so license('test', 'Distrib_Computing_Toolbox') is 1 and the parallel branch (lines 49-90) runs; the sequential loop (missed lines) is exempt as reachable only without the toolbox. A stand-in for the built-in license (as testGetParallelPool does for isParallelToolboxAvailable) was probed and rejected: MATLAB prints the warning 'Function license has the same name as a MATLAB built-in' on every call. The coverage tool does not count the parfor body (lines 63-86) as executable (hits would be recorded on the worker). The test passes numCores = 1 and, for the default-cores section, opens a one-worker pool itself (openParallelPool(1), 'Processes' profile, about 4 s) so that feature('numcores') is read without starting a pool with every core; the function closes every pool it finds (closeParallelPool), including one open before the call, which the header states. Machine-dependent run-time callees (only with the toolbox): src/base/utilities/toolboxFree/getParallelPool.m, openParallelPool.m, closeParallelPool.m. Relative output names are resolved in the workers' folder, which is the client folder at pool start, so the test cd's into the tempname folder before opening the pool. No tempdir leftovers from the worker processes were observed. No quarantined function is reached.

defects.title: Reaction colours written in lower case are not counted as present
defects.trigger: a map in the folder whose present reactions have the line colour 'ffff4500' (lower case, as CellDesigner writes colours when it saves a map) instead of 'FFFF4500'
defects.observed: MATLAB R2025a: no reaction of that map is counted as present (its column of rxnPrsTable is all false), as strcmp with 'FFFF4500' is case-sensitive.
defects.expected: the reactions of that colour counted as present, whatever the case

defects.title: A colour scheme without a row for the lowest presence fraction stops with an index error
defects.trigger: visualizeNormalizedRxnPresence(mapDir, {1, 'aaaaaa', 10; 0.5, 'bbbbbb', 5}) with a reaction whose presence fraction is below 0.5 and differs from the listed fractions (for example a reaction present in no map)
defects.observed: MATLAB R2025a: error 'Index in position 1 exceeds array bounds. Index must not exceed 2.' at line 150, where the range test reads the fraction of the next row.
defects.expected: an error naming the incomplete scheme, or the colour of its last row

notes: Lead to decide: the second defect is classified 'limitation' (the scheme does not cover the fraction, so the input is incomplete and only the error message is poor); if the lead reads it as 'error' (documented input, the documentation does not require a final row with fraction 0), the row becomes QUARANTINED and the test must be rewritten in the quarantine layout. Reproduction (MATLAB R2025a): with the four maps of the test (R4 present in no map), visualizeNormalizedRxnPresence(mapsFolder, {1, 'aaaaaa', 10; 0.5, 'bbbbbb', 5}) -> 'Index in position 1 exceeds array bounds. Index must not exceed 2.' (visualizeNormalizedRxnPresence line 150); with the default scheme every fraction in [0, 1] is matched before the next row is read. First defect reproduction: a toy map with line colour 'ffff4500' gives a column of false in rxnPrsTable while the same map with 'FFFF4500' gives true. Parallel branch as for visualizeFluxTimeseriesFromFile: toolbox licensed, sequential loop (missed lines) exempt, parfor body (lines 97-104) not counted as executable, license stand-in rejected (warning on every call), numCores = 1 or a one-worker pool opened by the test; machine-dependent run-time callees src/base/utilities/toolboxFree/getParallelPool.m, openParallelPool.m, closeParallelPool.m. Documented behaviour worth knowing: the heatmap is written into the input folder, so a second run on the same folder reads it as one more map; the test deletes its own heatmap between calls. No quarantined function is reached.

Expected colours from createColorsMap (ORANGERED 'FFFF4500', POWDERBLUE 'FFB0E0E6') and unifyMetabolicMapCD (grey 'FFDCDCDC', white); the .mat files hold a struct with the field rxns only (the function reads nothing else). Parallel branch as for visualizeFluxTimeseriesFromFile: toolbox licensed, sequential loop (missed lines) exempt, parfor body (lines 53-77) not counted as executable, license stand-in rejected (warning on every call), numCores = 1 or a one-worker pool opened by the test; machine-dependent run-time callees src/base/utilities/toolboxFree/getParallelPool.m, openParallelPool.m, closeParallelPool.m. The output files 'MicroMap_<name>.xml' are written relative to the current folder (in the parallel branch the workers' folder, which is the client folder at pool start), so the test cd's into an output folder before the call and before opening its pool; the warning 'Model variable not found in file: other.mat' is printed as designed (not suppressed). The error for a folder without .mat files is checked with verifyCobraFunctionError. No quarantined function is reached.
